articleTitle: Relationship between Power Flow Transferring and Path Length using Graph Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Unexpected power changes may lead to transmission line overload and even evolve into cascading breakout. To avoid this, the key is to analyze how the power flow transfers after disturbance. When the scale of the system is large, the accurate calculation of power flow transferring will require a lot of calculation and become more difficult. From the perspective of complex network, we build a bridge between path length and power correlation rate. The former is an inherent property of the network, and the latter is an electrical quantity for a specific power disturbance. We find that power, similar to liquids, tends to flow along the fast-moving path, that is, the path with short path length. Finally, the results are verified in radial and ring network respectively. It is hoped that this will provide an intuitive understanding for power system operators.

articleTitle: Acid and Alkali Resistance of Cycloaliphatic Epoxy Resin Insulators
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In order to study the acid and alkali resistance of the novel hard cycloaliphatic epoxy resin insulator sheath material, two frequently used cycloaliphatic epoxy resins (hexahydrohsphenol-A diglycidyl ether/ hexahydrophthalate diglycidyl ester) are selected and immersed in 2% HCl and NaOH solution at room temperature (25°C). Through surface roughness, static contact angle, scanning electron microscope and fourier infrared spectroscopy tests, the surface morphology and chemical structure stability of the two cycloaliphatic epoxy resins under different immersion times are analyzed. The results show that both cycloaliphatic epoxy resins do not have obvious corrosion in acidic environment, but in alkaline environment, both cycloaliphatic epoxy resins are corroded and aged. The corrosion of cycloaliphatic epoxy resins in acidic and alkaline environments originates from hydrolysis of ester bonds, so the corrosion of hexahydrophthalate diglycidyl ester with more ester bonds is more severe.

articleTitle: Parallel Research of POWER MOSFETs based on SVPWM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In the field of motor control, parallelled MOSFETs is often used as the power output module in order to pursue the miniaturization of motor controller. Although many characteristics of MOSFET are easy to be used in parallel, the problem of overcurrent caused by the inconsistency of switching process has not been solved fundamentally. In this paper, the current state of the power device applied to the SVPWM control algorithm at the moment of commutation is analyzed in detail. The problem of power device switching inconsistencies is solved under the general topology, which makes the current transition smoothly in the body-diode and forward FET circulation. After these, the parallel characteristics of non-commutation time are optimized according to the interaction characteristics of zero-vector and non-zero vector. The significant effect of the scheme is proved by the comparison of experimental waveform results and temperature rise. This scheme provides strong support for the application of parallel MOSFET in motor control field.

articleTitle: Three-port Network for Single-Stage Bridgeless LED Driver with Power Pulsation Decoupling Capability
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: High-brightness light-emitting diodes (HB-LEDs) is next generation of green lighting. However, the bulky electrolytic capacitor in converters is required to compensate the difference of pulsating power, thereby restricting the lifetime of the whole system. Meanwhile, the existence of full-bridge rectifier circuit and multi-stage transformation hinders the further improvement of power density. In this paper, a three-port network for single-stage bridgeless LED driver is proposed with the way of sharing so as to reduce the use of devices, thus higher power density is achieved; and additional port dedicated to power decoupling function so as to dramatically reduce the decoupling capacitance, thus allowing for film capacitors to be used. Operating principle, design considerations and performance comparisons are examined in detail. Finally, all the superior performances of proposed LED driver are verified by the PSIM platform.

articleTitle: Classification of the Distributed Capacitance and Voltage Distribution of V-Arranged Triple-Break Series Vacuum Circuit Breakers
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to classify distributed capacitance of a V-arranged triple-break vacuum circuit breaker (VCB). The distributed capacitance of the VCB was obtained by a commercial software Q3D. The results suggested that the distributed capacitance can be classified into three types: self-capacitance of the vacuum interrupter (VI), stray capacitance to ground and structural stray capacitance. Therefore, based on the three types of capacitance, the voltage distribution of the triple-break VCB can be simplified from an electric field problem into a circuit problem. The voltage distribution can be analyzed conveniently by control variable method in Matlab/Simulink software. The simulation results indicated that the roles of the three types of distributed capacitance. The self-capacitance of the VI tries to distribute the voltage among the triple breaks uniformly. On the other hand, the stray capacitance to the ground significantly caused the voltage distribution uneven, and the structural stray capacitance slightly caused the voltage distribution uneven.

articleTitle: Simulation Optimization and Experimental Research on Dynamic Characteristics and Contact Bounce of Inclined Pole Surface AC Contactor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems such as violent contact bounce, low utilization rate of core and coil materials of traditional AC contactor , the dynamic characteristics and contact bounce of AC contactors with different inclined angles surface are simulated and analyzed based on electromagnetics and multi-body dynamics. On this basis, the improved pigeon colony optimization algorithm is used to optimize the electromagnetic mechanism of AC contactor, and the movement process of the armature and contact are captured by high-speed camera to verify the simulation results. Experimental results show that the contact bounce of AC contactor with inclined pole surface is effectively restrained, the core and coil materials are greatly reduced, and the economic benefits are improved.

articleTitle: Research on a Novel AC Side Start-up Strategy for Hybrid Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In the uncontrolled charging stage of hybrid modular multilevel converter, the inconsistency of charging states between full bridge submodules and half bridge submodules will lead to the problem of capacitor voltage imbalance, which makes all traditional AC side controlled start-up schemes unavailable. To solve this problem, a hybrid modular multilevel converter AC side start-up strategy based on orthogonal decomposition of bridge arm voltage is proposed. In this strategy, the start-up process of hybrid modular multilevel converter is divided into three stages. In the third stage, the half bridge submodule is charged while the full bridge submodule voltage is kept unchanged by orthogonal decomposition of bridge arm voltage. The basic principle of the strategy is analyzed in detail, and a complete control strategy is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Improved Droop Control Scheme for Reactive Power Sharing of Parallel Inverter System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The droop control strategy is widely used in parallel inverter systems. However, when the line impedance of each inverter is not matched, it will result in the reactive power sharing error. At the same time, due to the droop characteristics, the output voltage accuracy will be reduced. Aiming at the reactive power sharing error and voltage control accuracy in droop control, an improved droop control scheme is proposed. First, the principle of droop control is introduced, and the power sharing model is established. Secondly, a multidimensional adaptive droop control strategy is proposed to achieve better reactive power sharing performance. Then, the frequency and voltage compensation control is added to improve the accuracy of PCC voltage. Finally, a simulation model of the parallel inverter system is built to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Development and Partial Discharge Characteristics of the White Mark on Pressboard Under Step-stress Voltage
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The white mark is a typical fault in surface discharge of oil-paper insulation in transformers. There is a certain correlation between the white mark and the deterioration of insulation. Obtaining morphological characteristics of the white mark is significant for the evaluation of insulation, but it is difficult to detect because it easily vanishes. In this paper, the growth of the white mark under extremely uneven electric field is studied under stepstress voltage, and the morphology is observed and partial discharge signals are measured. The results show that the morphology and partial discharge characteristics of the white mark at different stages show a good relationship, and PRPD patterns show a trend of gradually denser discharge. Moreover, the area of the white mark is consistent with the cumulative energy of discharge over time. In the diagnosis of fault, the cumulative energy of discharge, PRPD patterns and N-Q distribution histogram are of reference value.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Fabry Perot Effect in Terahertz Time Domain Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper uses the parameter extraction model of the transmission terahertz time-domain spectroscopy technology to theoretically simulate the terahertz time-domain signal of the sample, and then simulates and analyzes the Fabry-Perot effect. The simulated sample signal is very close to the measured sample signal. Through simulation, the influence of thickness, refractive index, and extinction coefficient on the terahertz time-domain signal is analyzed. Finally, suggestions for sample detection and signal processing of terahertz time-domain spectroscopy are put forward.

articleTitle: Optimization of Series Reactors and VAR Compensators Installation for Inhibiting Multiinfeed HVDC Commutation Failure
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The multi-infeed HVDC systems are closely coupled between the inverter stations, which is easy to cause concurrent commutation failures (CFs). In this paper, the electrical distance is adjusted by the installation of series reactors (SRs) to reduce the multi-infeed interaction factor (MIIF). At the same time, reactive power (VAR) compensators are added at some buses with SRs installed to control the voltage drop and power flow of the system. Finally, a mathematical model for the SRs and VAR compensators installation is established, and the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to optimize the installation. The simulation results of the power grid show that the optimized installation can inhibit the problem of concurrent CFs.

articleTitle: Study on Asynchronous Torque of Brushless Double-Fed Machine with Negative Pole-pairs
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, an asynchronous operation mode of brushless doubly-fed machine (BDFM) with negative pole-pairs is introduced based on the principle of field differential modulation. The machine has the characteristics of negative pole-pairs under the magnetic field modulation of the specially designed rotor. This means that the rotor can rotate in reverse and operate stably when the three-phase positive sequence voltage is applied to the stator power wingding (PW) end of the machine. The electromagnetic braking torque of the traditional induction motor becomes the driving torque in BDFM with negative pole pairs. This paper first analyzes the reasons for the phenomenon of negative pole-pairs, calculates the asynchronous torque, then analyzes the influence of different factors on the starting torque, and finally validates its rationality through finite element simulation.

articleTitle: On-line detection of transformer excitation parameters based on fundamental wave extraction
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The safe and stable operation of transformer is very important to the operation of power system. The excitation parameters can reflect the health and operation state of transformer winding, and the real-time monitoring of transformer excitation parameters is of great significance for the elimination of potential faults. At present, the identification of transformer excitation parameters is based on the excitation current containing harmonic components, which is difficult to calculate and requires a lot of calculation. In this paper, a fundamental wave extraction method based on the Second-Order Generalized-Integrator Frequency-Locked-Loop (SOGI-FLL) is introduced. The SOGI-FLL is used to extract the fundamental wave of the primary and secondary side voltage and current, and the transformer circuit equation is used for calculation, and then the excitation impedance parameters of the transformer are obtained. Finally, the effectiveness of the identification method for transformer condition monitoring is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Design of anti-rust scheme of transmission tower based on the distribution characteristics of rust factor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: A single level of anti-rust design will usually lead to serious corrosion of parts of the tower. Based on the distribution characteristics of rust factor, this paper puts forward the concept of graded rust prevention design for transmission tower, and gives specific suggestions for rust prevention treatment. This paper takes a transmission tower as an example, carries out a graded anti-rust design, and takes corresponding treatment measures. The results show that the design scheme can guarantee the same anti-rust life of the whole tower as far as possible.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of ICP source Impedance and Experimental Verification
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Obtaining the equivalent impedance of the Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP) source driver is very important in the design of impedance matching circuit. For this reason, we built a 3D model in MAXWELL software. The plasma is equivalent to a uniform conductive medium. The electromagnetic field under the condition of 1MHz excitation current is solved. And we calculated the equivalent impedance of the driver by means of vector volume integration. Then we used the potassium chloride (kcl) solution with a certain conductivity to simulate plasma. It was put into the driver and we measured the impedance of the driver. The simulation results and the measurement result were compared and verified.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis and Improvement of an V/f controlled Induction Motor Drive Taking the Effect of Inverter Deadtime
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Asynchronous machine(AM) V/f control system suffer sustained oscillation in light load conditions. Both deadtime compensation(DCS) and constant excitation current control (CECC) system were proposed to suppress the system oscillation. However, DCS cannot suppress the oscillation in some hostile frequencies and the response is slow. And PI parameters of the CECC are difficult to confirm in the entire oscillation frequency. In this paper, the influence of different dead time on Asynchronous motor control system stability is discussed by establishing a small signal model of asynchronous motor including deadtime. And a method is proposed combined DCS with CECC, which can suppress the oscillation under light load and promote stator phase current harmonic performance. The simulation results based on an 7.5kW AM open-loop drive system are presented to confirm the validity the proposed method.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control Strategy for Multiphase Induction Motor with Stator and Rotor Resistance Identification Based on Injecting Third Harmonic Current
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: It is no longer a problem to operate an induction machine stably with sensorless control, but it is a new challenge to make induction motor system high performance without speed sensor. This paper focus on high performance sensorless control strategy with parameters identification for multiphase induction machines. This method firstly has the advantage of sensorless algorithm. Secondly, accurate rotor magnetic field orientation because of rotor resistance estimation online improves the dynamic performance of the motor and reduces the loss. Additionally, precise rotor resistance, which supplied by third harmonic plane, can increase the stability of system at low speed and negative speed. It is noted that injection of 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> harmonic current not only would not bring extra torque ripple, but also can increase torque density of the motor. Finally, to validate the feasibility of proposed method, simulation results by using Matlab/Simulink are shown in the paper.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Electromagnetic Interference of High-voltage Pulse Source
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, the electromagnetic interference of a high voltage pulse discharge device is simulated and analyzed. The interference source, transmission route, and sensitive equipment are identified. The electromagnetic interference (EMI) problem is analyzed in detail by using the field-circuit cooperative electromagnetic simulation software CST. The simulation results show the voltage coupling caused by the high voltage of the main discharge to the electronic circuit of the control module, and the interference caused by the external electromagnetic pulse to the internal cable. Besides, through the simulation of the shielding effectiveness of the enclosure, some suggestions are given so that this kind of enclosure can resist electromagnetic interference from both outside and inside. By referring to the simulation of the electromagnetic interference mentioned in this paper, readers can get the ideas and methods of how they can use CST to deal with similar electromagnetic interference problems in their own device. This paper also shed light on the approach to distinguish the key elements of electromagnetic interference in similar devices or situations that contain both high power equipment and low power electronic equipment.

articleTitle: Adaptive Form of Generator Stator Ground Fault Protection for the Floating Nuclear Power Plant Grid-Source Direct Connection System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Due to the high concentration of electricity generation and distribution in the floating nuclear power plant grid-source direct connection system, the generator stator ground fault protection is affected by the direct connection power grid. Traditional protection methods cannot distinguish the fault direction and are difficult to guarantee the extreme safety requirements of the nuclear islands. This paper analyzes the system ground fault, points out the limitations of the existing generator stator ground protection methods, and proposes an adaptive form of generator stator ground fault protection method. Based on the phase-current differential, the method can effectively distinguish the faults inside or outside the generator, which can also form the protection criterion and action strategies according to the fault degree. It can trip the generator smoothly under slight fault conditions, ensuring the safe and stable operation of the floating nuclear power plant. Simulation in PSCAD/EMTDC proves that the proposed method can effectively realize the selective coordination of the ground fault protection for the grid-source direct connection system.

articleTitle: Study on Relationship between Cumulative Discharge Energy and Discharge Marks on Pressboard under High Field Strength
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The insulation field strength of the UHV transformer is close to the design limit, which leads to the continuous increase of the working field strength of the oilpaper insulation structure. In order to explore the correlation between the development of PD and surface discharge marks on pressboard under high field strength, this paper used an extremely uneven electric field with a strong vertical component to study the development process of discharge marks and PD parameters under high field strength. The research found that PD under high field strength could cause serious damage to pressboard, resulted in white marks, spark discharge channels and carbonized marks. Based on the discharge repetition rate and discharge energy, the PD could be divided into three stages named initial stage, fast extension stage and near breakdown stage respectively. The development of cumulative discharge energy and the growth of carbonized mark have the same law in three stages.

articleTitle: Research on Saturation Characteristics and Modeling Method for Transformer Based on J-A Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of high voltage direct current transmission (HVDC) in China, the saturation problem of transformers has gradually become a hot spot. To study the internal characteristics of the transformer when saturated. Firstly, the magnetization branch of transformer is established based on the Jiles-Atherton(J-A) model. Then a three-phase transformer model considering saturation is established in MATLAB, and the model is used to analyze the harmonic changes of excitation current and the winding current under different load conditions by injecting DC into the neutral point. The result shows that the core is half-cycle saturated after the injection of DC, the current distort ion of the primary winding is mainly related to the excitation current, which is manifested by even harmonics that increase rapidly and the phase core with more direct current intrusion is more saturated.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Flying-Capacitor Modular Multilevel Converter Based on SiC MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Reducing the capacitor voltage ripple amplitude of the modular multilevel converter (MMC) submodule is expected to reduce the capacitance of the module capacitors, which is very important for the increase of the power density. In the method of reducing capacitor voltage fluctuations of MMC submodule, flying-capacitor modular multilevel converter (FC-MMC) has gained extensive attentions because of its good performance. It is characterized by the connection of upper and lower arm middle taps through a flying capacitor in per phase arm. However, the reduction of the capacitance of flying capacitor requires an increase in switching frequency, which means high switching loss for the converter. Therefore, SiC MOSFET has a good application prospect in FC-MMC due to its low switching loss. This paper mainly compares the capacitor voltage fluctuation between FC-MMC and MMC, and the advantages of SiC MOSFET in FC-MMC applications.

articleTitle: Corrective Power Network Reconfiguration for Eliminating Transmission Lines Overload
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The power flow of transmission lines may be overloaded when contingencies occur. To solve this problem effectively, this paper proposes a two-staged optimization model, which considers spinning reserve resources and network adjustment. Firstly, a DC power flow based mathematical model of network reconfiguration is introduced to obtain an approximate optimal solution. Then an AC power flow based mathematical model of network reconfiguration is introduced, and the obtained approximate optimal solution is used as an initial state. The proposed model is a mixed integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) model, because it considers the AC power flow constraints and introduces binary integer variables. The branch and bound method and the primal dual interior point method are used to solve the MINLP problem. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed methods are verified by simulations on Fujian transmission grids.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of GIS Defects and Major Condition Parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Gas insulated switchgear (GIS) plays an important role in the power grid. At present, the defect detection and condition assessment of GIS involves many condition parameters that are obtained with power outage. Therefore, the maintenance of GIS brings a lot of pressure on the Power supply bureau. In this paper, based on the data sheet about 538 GIS equipment and 10 years operations, the defects and relevant condition parameters were statistically analyzed. The distribution of GIS defects with the type of detection and components, and the defect rate with the operating years were obtained. Major condition parameters were analyzed, and seven condition parameters were chosen to perform the maintenance of GIS. These seven condition parameters can be obtained without power outage and more than 97% defects can be found out through them.

articleTitle: Analysis of Pulse Transformer Using New Winding Method Based on Electromagnetic Field Simulation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The pulse transformer is usually used in a high -power pulse generator, and its property and reliability are critical indexes to a pulse generator. In this paper, a pulse transformer was analyzed based on the electromagnetic field simulation software and circuit simulation software. By customizing the high-performance magnetic core and using the new winding method, the output power and insulation of the pulse transformer are improved. The electromagnetic field distribution of the pulse transformer with improved windings is simulated in the electromagnetic field simulation software. Various characteristic parameters are shown of the pulse transformer, including the electrostatic field, eddy current field, and the working state of the transient field. Compared with the classic winding method, the simulation results show that the pulse transformer with improved windings has a better improvement in safety and parasitic parameters, and it has a better performance in the rising/falling edge and flat-top of a pulse.

articleTitle: Research on Electrical Characteristics of Insulating Silicone Oil Based on Polarization-Depolarization Current Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The DC conductivity and 0.1Hz dielectric loss factor of insulating silicone oil with different water content were measured by polarization-depolarization current method. The influence of water content in insulating silicone oil on polarization-depolarization current curve is analyzed, and the reason why the DC conductivity and 0.1 Hz dielectric loss factor of insulating silicone oil increase with increasing water content is given. Measured 15s and 60s insulation resistance and power frequency dielectric loss factor, the results show that with the increase of water content in insulating silicone oil, the trend of 15 s and 60 s insulation resistance is opposite to that of DC conductivity, the trend of power frequency dielectric loss factor is the same as that of 0.1Hz dielectric loss factor, the effectiveness of the polarization-depolarization current method in detecting DC conductivity and 0.1 Hz dielectric loss factor of insulating silicone oil is verified.

articleTitle: Overvoltage measurement method based on non-contact wireless measurement
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Effective monitoring of transient overvoltage is the key to field testing, fault analysis and optimal design of power systems. Nowadays, the voltage monitoring and overvoltage monitoring of the power grid mostly use the traditional contact voltage divider system. This measurement method needs to be connected to a device to obtain the signal, which has certain safety hazards and has a narrow measurement frequency band, weak anti-electromagnetic interference ability, and poor installation and maintenance. Therefore, research on the grid overvoltage non-contact sensor with good broadband response characteristics can effectively avoid the cumbersome coaxial cable wiring at the test site, and eliminate the risk of personal electric shock caused by the wired test of high-voltage equipment. It is safe, reliable, and can provide data support for further research. This paper studies a non-contact overvoltage measurement system based on an integrated electro-optic field sensor and applies it to on-site measurement. The on-site testing results of the measurement system are compared with the waveform recorded by the fault recorder to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Optimization of Magnetic Pole Structure of High-speed Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Weakens Cogging Torque
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In order to suppress the cogging torque of permanent magnet synchronous motors, a layered permanent magnet structure composed of different permanent magnet materials is proposed. The multiphysics coupling analysis of the electromagnetic field and the temperature field of the permanent magnet motor in ANSYS software was performed to obtain the temperature difference between the stator and the rotor due to air gap wind milling during the motor operation. Based on this, the temperature can be used near the stator layer of the permanent magnet. A low-coefficient magnetic material can effectively reduce the harmonic content of the air gap magnetic flux density of the motor, thereby reducing the cogging torque. Finally, a differential algorithm is used to optimize the thickness of the permanent magnet material on the outer surface to obtain the permanent magnet size parameters that make the motor better. Simulation results show that the layered permanent magnet structure can effectively reduce the cogging torque of the permanent magnet motor and effectively improve the sine of the back-EMF waveform after optimized design.

articleTitle: Dynamic Economic Dispatch of Power Systems with Optimal Transmission Switching
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Dynamic economic dispatch with optimal transmission switching is proposed for wind integrated power systems to improve wind power consumption and reduce system operating costs. Firstly, an optimal model for wind power systems is introduced based on the DC power flow equation. Furthermore, in order to solve the mixed integer programming problem for large-scale power systems, a pre-screening descending dimension algorithm is proposed, which pre-screens the total transmission lines to establish the candidate breakable line set, in where the selected lines can reduce the generation and wind curtailment cost. Meanwhile, a solution strategy for the dynamic economic dispatch model is proposed. The original integrated model is solved in two stages: line pre-screening and optimal dispatch. And big-M reduction is used to further improve solution efficiency. Consequently, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed model and acceleration algorithm are proved in the improved IEEE24 and IEEE118 system, respectively.

articleTitle: Equilibrium Models of Electricity Market Considering Electric Vehicles and Renewable Energy Trading Priority
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Because of severe uncertainty of renewable energy, how to tackle the deviations between the actual outputs and bid outputs becomes one of the most sensitive issues in day-ahead electricity markets. A joint planning and operation strategy of renewable energy producer and electric vehicles aggregator is capable of reducing the deviations. In this paper, a stochastic Cournot equilibrium model of the electricity market is proposed. Based on the oligopolistic competition theory, a virtual power plant including renewable energy producer and electric vehicles aggregator bids in a cooperative mode to participate in the market competition. Moreover, trading priority of renewable energy is considered to ensure the market fairness. This model is solved by the mixed complementarity method. Results show that renewable energy producer bids more profitable as well as alleviating the outputs deviations.

articleTitle: Study on the Corresponding Relationship Between Critical Points of P-V Curve and V-Q Curve of Simple Thevenin Equivalent System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the further increase in power demand for highly concentrated load centers and the gradual formation of a power system with a high proportion of new energy sources, China will face severe risk of voltage instability. In this paper, firstly, the load bus voltage equation of simple Thevenin equivalent system is derived, and then the P-V and V-Q curves are obtained respectively. Secondly, the mutual restriction relationship between active and reactive power of load is discussed when there is a real value solution to the voltage. Finally, the relationship between the voltage of critical points of the P-V curves and the reactive power of the load, and the relationship between the voltage of critical points of the V-Q curves and the active power of the load are deduced respectively. The relationship of one-to-one correspondence between critical points of P-V curves and critical points of V-Q curves is proved according to the mutual restriction between active power and reactive power of load and monotonicity of critical voltage and load power function.

articleTitle: Study on the Magnet Design and Beam Extraction in a Superconducting Cyclotron
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: A 250MeV superconducting cyclotron (SCC250) for proton therapy is being constructed at Huazhong university of science and technology (HUST). A well-designed magnetic field and an excellent beam extraction are critical for obtaining the desired beam in the compact cyclotron. However, the high magnetic field brings about great challenges to achieve isochronism and high extraction efficiency. Poor field isochronism will cause severe particle acceleration problems. Besides, the enormous beam loss due to the small turn separation at the extraction region may lead to the damage of the superconducting system. This paper focuses on improving the field isochronism by cutting patches at different radii of the magnetic pole, and increasing the turn separation by adjusting the amplitude and phase of the first harmonic field. The resonances tune and the acceleration process are also optimized to acquire a high-quality beam. Calculations show that the error accuracy AB/B is smaller than 3 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>, which meets the requirement of beam acceleration. And the turn separation can reach 7mm, which reduces the beam loss to an acceptable level.

articleTitle: Design of high-speed data acquisition and management system for negative ion source
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Negative ion source usually needs to collect the systems' operation information that can be useful for optimizing its design. In this case, the data is fast updating and uploaded through the Ethernet but the data storage operation is time-consuming. Regarding this process, it can also easily lead to data loss when multi-subsystems are uploading data concurrently. Aware of this issue and aiming to solve it, a three-level structure is proposed - each of them with an independent module for every subsystem. The first level is the hardware level that can sample and upload data to the second level through UDP. Further on, the acquired information is transferred from the second base using ZMQ. After the test, ZMQ application could solve the problem of the mismatch between the uploading speed and the storage speed, effectively reducing data loss.

articleTitle: Static Field Calculation of an Octupole Scanning Magnet
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Scanning magnets are applied to spot scanning procedures in proton therapy. Two separated dipole magnets are mostly used to deflect the beam in two orthogonal directions. Since the overall size of scanning magnets in beam axis is one main factor to determine gantry radius, it is desired to have a compact design. Recent years, a multipole scanning magnet has been proposed which can generate a circular magnet field with dynamic configuration of coil currents.In this paper, the number of poles of the multipole magnet was chosen to be eight after some comparisons. The distribution of the transverse field of the octupole magnet was calculated and the influence of different shapes of pole tips on the quality of the magnetic field is analyzed in Opera-2D. The rotation performance of its magnetic field was also studied by changing the phase of current in coils both in Opera 2D and 3D. The quality of the integrated field was performed and the distribution of its relative harmonic field errors were calculated.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on Mechanica Properties of Ultrahigh Voltage Disconnector in Cold Condition
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: High voltage disconnector is widely used in power system, but the cold environment brings new challenges and difficulties to its operation and maintenance technology. To study the effect of cold conditions on its mechanical properties, and get the extraction to represent the characteristics of its running state, 550 kV anti-pollution double column single arm horizontal telescopic disconnector was selected as test sample, and the test platform was also established. Then, stator current, output shaft strain, and power output during the closing and opening process were measured at room temperature and low temperature. The test results shows that compared with room temperature, the variation rules of stator current, output shaft strain and output power do not change significantly in switching process under the cold conditions, but the amplitude all increase to different degrees, and the electromechanical flow curve cannot be used as the characteristic quantity to judge the mechanical state of the isolating switch.

articleTitle: Front-end Signal Synthesis Design of Low-Level Radio Frequency Control System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The front-end signal synthesis has a great influence on the detection and control accuracy of the Low-Level Radio Frequency control system. It is used as the signal source of the control system and the access port connected with the Radio Frequency system. It generated the operation frequency signal, the local oscillator signal, and the clock signal. This paper analyzed the principle of the synthesis module, studied the harmonics and phase noise models, and completed the design of the signal synthesis hardware scheme. On this basis, MATLAB/Simulink modeled and simulated the entire signal synthesis module, and the device test was carried out according to the hardware scheme, and the signals output with high stability and low phase noise were realized.

articleTitle: Study on shock wave in underwater pulsed discharge based on finite element analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: A method based on finite element analysis is proposed in the study on the propagation characteristics of shock waves generated by underwater pulsed discharge. The energy deposited curve during discharge was obtained. Finite element models of the discharge channel and surrounding water were established. The discharge channel was simplified as ideal gas. Combined with the energy deposited curve, the expansion process of the discharge channel in water was simulated. Waveforms of shock waves at different times and positions were obtained. The simulation results are in good agreement with the experimental results. Mesh division and the initial relative volume of the discharge channel would affect the rise time and fall time of the shock wave. Shock waves generated by underwater pulsed discharge and underwater explosion were compared. They have similar attenuation characteristics, but the shock wave in underwater explosion have a larger peak value and slower attenuation in the near field.

articleTitle: The Influence of Gas Pressure and Voltage on Surface Charge Behavior of Basin Type Insulator
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The numerical model of surface charge accumulation was established based on a 252 kV basin type insulator. The influence of applied voltage and gas pressure on charge accumulation is analyzed. The simulation results show that both positive and negative ions near the insulator decreases with the increase of voltage, but the surface charge density increases and the growth rate gradually decreases. With the increase of SF6 gas pressure, the concentration of positive and negative ions in GIL would also increase and the concentration distribution of positive and negative ions would be more uniform. When the gas pressure ranges from 0.1 MPa to 0.7 MPa, the charge density on insulator surface increases. And the surface charge density shows a trend of gradual saturation.

articleTitle: Integrated energy system planning taking into account the energy type and photovoltaic uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Integrated energy system(IES) refers to a variety of energy in the coupling of electricity, gas, heat energy in the form of management, distribution and application of the system, is the expression of energy in the Internet area, this paper constructs the IES structure of the park, using the energy hub model to analyze the cell transformation relationship, and constructed the mathematical model of the structure of the unit, and presents a total cost as the objective function, considering the photovoltaic output and the user can use kinds of uncertainty planning method. The example is solved by using BONMIN, and in a 3 energy unit planning examples verily the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Frequency Coupling of Asymmetrical VSC-dominated Power Systems in Small-signal Dynamic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The frequency coupling has brought great challenges to the small-signal dynamic analysis of the VSC-dominated power systems. However, few have cognized the essence of the frequency coupling, especially its inner relationship with the asymmetry of the system. Thus, this paper will emphatically study the frequency coupling of the asymmetrical VSC-dominated power systems in the small-signal dynamic analysis. First, this paper will summarize the asymmetrical factors of VSC and the power network. Then, the effects of the system's asymmetry on the frequency coupling will be analyzed. The results indicate that the asymmetry of VSC and the power network can induce the frequency coupling of the linearized VSC-dominated power systems. Moreover, the utilized coordinate for system modeling and analysis have great effects on the frequency coupling. Therefore, by choosing the appropriate coordinate according to the asymmetries of VSC and the power network, this system can also be modeled and analyzed with the linear time invariant (LTI) methods, rather than the complicated linear time periodic (LTP) methods. Eventually, the time domain simulations will verify the correctness of the analysis.

articleTitle: Upgrade of Operation Mode of Bipolar Pulse Power Supply on J-TEXT
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the in-depth study on the physical mechanism of mode locking, penetrating and tearing mode suppression, the original RMP power supply system has been unable to meet the experimental requirements. In order to make RMP coils have more connection methods to generate more diverse magnetic field configuration and larger current, this paper redesigns a new control system for bipolar pulse AC power supply, which make it upgrade to a power supply that can operate in DC operation mode, moreover, the output current can be reversed in one shot. Besides, the control strategy, protection, real-time detection and waveform display can meet the requirements of normal operation. Finally, performance of this new control system is tested on bipolar pulse power supply.

articleTitle: A Method of Power Supply Time Period Division Based on Optimal Division Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>In view of the relatively large peak-valley difference of the existing state grid company and the lack of clear peak-valley time period, this paper proposed a method for dividing the peak-valley time period based on the optimal division method and designs some orderly charging strategies. The peak-shaving and valley-filling of grid power supply can relieve the existing power supply pressure of the grid. Here, starting from the power supply stability of the power grid and taking into account user satisfaction, a Bi-level programming model is established to provide an orderly charging strategy. Finally, an algorithm model is established through genetic algorithm to calculate a reasonable power supply plan. Through experimental comparison, it is found that the algorithm scheme provided in this paper has the advantages of peak-shaving and valley-filling and smoothing of grid load for the state grid company.

articleTitle: Ozone Emission and Electric Characters of Wire-plate Corona Discharge
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Ozone emission of corona discharge has been studied for many years. We use Differential Optical Absorption Spectroscopy (DOAS) to build an optical detection system with a limit of 465 ppm and precision of 0.01 ppm to detect the ozone concentration, on this basis, we investigated the effect of voltage, materials, number of electrodes and gas flow on ozone emission. Compared with the negative corona discharge, positive corona produces a small amount of ozone at the same voltage, and more ozone is produced in positive pulse than that in positive DC. The electrode materials do not change the current-voltage characteristics of corona discharge, but silver and copper significantly reduce ozone production. The number of electrodes affects the electric field distribution thus the electron density is changed. At the same current, the more electrodes, the less ozone is generated. With the increase of gas flow, the ozone concentration decreases and reaches saturation concentration within a shorter time.

articleTitle: Design of an Inductor-Integrated Transformer Applied to Inverter Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The cascaded H-bridges with carrier phase-shift SPWM can increase the equivalent switching frequency and improve the output voltage quality. When the cascaded H-bridges topology is applied to the line-frequency inverter power supply, the bulky magnetic components limit the power density of the power supply. This paper integrates the isolation transformers and filter inductors in the power supply, and develops an optimization design method of the transformer. Through integration and optimization design, the volume power density of the transformer is increased by 69.6%, and the weight power density is increased by 44.8%.

articleTitle: Development of a parameter design software for Hybrid HVDC
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the increasing capacity and transmission distance of the power grid, HVDC technology has been more and more widely used. MTDC is an essential direction for the development of HVDC technology. At this stage, LCC is widely used in the MTDC transmission project, and there is a lot of corresponding design software, but the software development of the hybrid DC transmission is not perfect and mature enough. In this paper, the design method of the parameters of the main loop in the LCC-MMC hybrid HVDC transmission system has been studied. The corresponding design software has been compiled, and this paper presents functional modules to be accomplished in the software package. The correctness of the software calculation is verified by the actual HVDC transmission project data, and the software can be applied to the initial design of the hybrid HVDC transmission project.

articleTitle: Simulation of Three-Dimensional Temperature Distribution for GIL Insulator based on FVM
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, a three-dimensional numerical analysis model of GIL subsection with a basin insulator inside is established. The temperature distribution in steady state is calculated by finite volume method. The temperature distribution of the insulator under different gas pressure is calculated. With the increase of gas pressure, the maximum temperature of insulator gradually decreases, and the minimum temperature of insulator barely changes. The results show that higher load current will result in higher insulator temperature, and the linear relationship between the ambient temperature and the insulator temperature is obtained.

articleTitle: Effects of Nonionic Surfactant and Repairing Agent Contents on the Performance of Clean-Repairing Agent for Silicon Rubber
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: A new kind of cleaning agent for aging insulators in power grid was reported, which can recover its hydrophobicity and insulation performance. The effects of different nonionic surfactants and repairing agents contents on the surface tension, washing efficiency, insulator contact angle, post washing hydrophobicity, post washing loss and transference of hydrophobicity were investigated. Experiments show that the cleaning efficiency is best when the nonionic surfactants content is 3%, and the average contact angle of the insulator after washing is about 126°. When the content of the repairing agent is 11%, its performance is the most superior in all aspects, and its hydrophobicity is the best, which can reach the HC1 level.

articleTitle: Quasi-PR Control Based Flexible Arc Suppression Method in Power Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: To ensure the reliable arc suppression of single-phase-to-ground fault in the power distribution networks, and improve the control performance of the arc-suppression equipment, a flexible arc-suppression method for the power distribution networks based on quasi-PR control is proposed in this paper. A three-phase cascaded H-bridge converter is utilized as the main circuit of the arc-suppression equipment, which is directly connected to the bus of the power distribution networks, and would realize full compensation for the single-phase-to-ground fault current. Besides, the digital realization of the quasi-PR controller is also discussed. Compared with the traditional PI controller, the quasi-PR controller can track sinusoidal signals with zero error, so as to obtain a better control effect. The simulation and experimental results show that the proposed method could achieve an excellent performance of suppressing fault current and extinguishing the arc.

articleTitle: A Datasheet - Based Loss Model and Efficiency Analysis for Vienna Rectifiers Using SiC Power Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper proposes a datasheet-based loss model and efficiency analysis of the SiC power devices based on three-phase three-level Vienna rectifier. Detailed power loss model for the semiconductor devices in the Vienna rectifier using carrier-based PWM (CB-PWM) modulation is presented. The power loss distribution over the semiconductor devices is compared among four different SiC MOSFETs and the optimal semiconductor is selected. Based on the calculated power loss, the thermal design is done and a maximum temperature rise of 69.29°C in power devices is observed according to the simulation result. Finally an air-forced cooled, 100kHz, 55kW Vienna rectifier is demonstrated and the semiconductor efficiency achieves 98.6%.

articleTitle: Microwave Reflectometer for Density Measurement on J-TEXT Tokamak
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Microwave reflectometer is an essential diagnostic tool with high spatial and temporal resolution for the measurement of plasma density profile. In recent years, a microwave reflectometry system has been developed and optimized on the J-TEXT tokamak. It consists of three parts: Q band (33-50GHz) with extra-ordinary mode (X-mode), V band (50-75GHz) with X mode and Q band with ordinary mode (O-mode). Its measurement range covers from the edge to core of the low field side plasma. To obtain a linear frequency sweep, the dynamic calibration of the voltage control oscillator (VCO) is completed. The profile measured by the reflectometer is in good agreement with the result of the polarimetry.

articleTitle: A CM EMI Suppression Strategy for the Single-Phase Inverter Based on the Si/SiC Hybrid Switch
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Numerous studies have shown that the Si IGBT/SiC MOSFET hybrid switch has been verified to be a high efficiency and cost-effective device for the application of the inverter. In fact, the high switching frequency of the SiC MOSFET means high dv/dt, which will generate severe common mode electromagnetic interference (CM EMI). Meanwhile, it would lead to some malfunction of the power converter. In order to suppress the CM EMI of the single-phase inverter based on the Si/SiC hybrid switch, a CM EMI suppression strategy combining the variable switching patterns and the variable switching frequency is proposed. Furthermore, the feasibility of the proposed method has been verified by experimental results distinctly.

articleTitle: Radial and Axial Temperature Distribution of Nano-second Pulsed Spark Discharge
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In order to study the radial and axial temperature distribution of nano-second pulse spark discharge, this paper uses SOS pulse power supply to discharge the stainless steel needle electrode, uses spectrometer and ICCD high-speed camera to diagnose the spectrum of plasma, and conducts comparative analysis with the software. It is found that when the absolute value of radial displacement increases, the vibration temperature decreases gradually. When the absolute value of axial displacement increases, the rotation temperature decreases gradually and the temperature near the anode is higher. These results indicate the plasma temperature at different positions and provide diagnostic basis for the application of spark discharge plasma.

articleTitle: Research on Temperature Field of All-film Pulsed Capacitors in Application of Repetitive Pulse Discharge
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In order to obtain the temperature field distribution of the all-film pulsed capacitors (AFPCs) under repetitive high-voltage pulse discharge conditions, we analyze the internal structure of the AFPC, and establish the temperature field simulation model. Based on the FEA, we obtain the overall temperature field distribution of the AFPC, and the relationship between discharge voltage, frequency, and temperature rise. This model can be used to evaluate the temperature rise characteristics of an AFPC in repetitive high-voltage pulse discharge and has certain guiding significance for the safe operation.

articleTitle: State Confirmation Method of Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The reliability of circuit breaker state identification greatly affects the application range of sequence control and remote control. And safety regulations require at least two criteria based on different identical principles and signals to determine the state of the equipment after operation. In this paper, based on the intelligent comparison of current and impedance, comprehensive criterion and warning technology of circuit breaker state is proposed. Based on the injection circuit, the current and voltage of the injected signal are detected and the characteristic change of zero sequence resistance is calculated to realize the on-Line loop impedance monitoring. And the loosing or aging problem of circuit breaker can be found out. While the state monitoring criterion of circuit breaker is proposed, which uses the existing measurement data to constitute the state confirmation criterion.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Foreign Object on LCC-LCC Electric Vehicle Wireless Charging System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Wireless charging is of great significance for accelerating the promotion of electric vehicles. In order to explore the influence of foreign object on wireless charging system, the circuit model and the magnetic circuit model are established to simulate the working status of LCC-LCC wireless charging system under the interference of foreign object. The circuit model is used to analyze the interference of the conductivity of foreign object on the system while the magnetic circuit model is used to analyze the interference of the magnetic properties of foreign objects on the system. The results prove that foreign object will increase power loss, change the equivalent parameters of the coil and destroy the magnetic field in the energy coupling area. The work of this paper has guiding significance for the design of foreign object detection system based on detection coils.

articleTitle: Online Multi-cascade DC Converter Impedance Measurement Method Based on Multi-sine Signal Injection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Impedance characteristics of DC converters in multi-cascaded system are important parameters for the stability analysis of multi-cascaded system. Since the impedance characteristics usually vary over time with operation conditions, therefore, online impedance measurement of multi-cascaded DC converter is required for the adaptively adjustment for the stability of multi-cascaded system. However single disturbance source is adopted in existing methods for online impedance measurement, which requires multiple disturbance signal injection while obtaining the impedance characteristics of multi-cascaded DC converters. In order to realize the rapid online measurement of DC converters, a multiple disturbance sources online measurement method based on multi-sine signal injection is proposed. The design method of frequency, amplitude and phases of each component in multi-sine signal is proposed in order to obtain accuracy measurement results. At last, simulation is conducted to verify the effectiveness of proposed method.

articleTitle: Application and research of air material transportation laboratory management system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In recent years, the air material transportation system has played an increasingly important role in many fields. However, traditional laboratory management methods cannot meet the requirements for real-time and high-level supervision capabilities of air material transportation laboratories. In order to solve this problem, the real-time database and cloud computing technology are used in this paper to design and improve laboratory management system. The paper discusses the feasibility of the real-time database and cloud computing technology and outlines the three aspects of the design: the overall architecture, network topology and data flow. According to the actual situation of an air material transportation laboratory, the real-time database architecture is designed to manage the massive test data, personnel information, and on-site monitoring equipment of the laboratory. Finally, the project realizes the functions of the system and makes laboratory management more intelligent.

articleTitle: An Information Fusion Charging Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>Based on the road network model, grid load information, and vehicle scheduling information in the charging station, a vehicle-pile-road-network-source information fusion multi-in-one orderly charging model is established. Among them, due to vehicle charging information and grid load information It changes in real time and needs to submit charging requirements at every time interval and upload to the server. The information includes geographic location information, battery attribute information, and SOC information. The charging station provides the current number of vehicles, the total number of vehicles accommodated, and the number of vehicles queued at the charging station. The power supply end of the grid provides current load power and maximum load power. Calculate the optimal station location and shortest route navigation for each vehicle based on the road network information, and distribute it to each system. Its advantage is that it can allocate vehicles reasonably during peak hours and solve the problem of traffic congestion.

articleTitle: Operation Analysis of Electromagnetic Loop Network in Distribution Network Based on Physical Test and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This research aims to analyze transient processes during loop closing and opening operations in distribution grids with DGs. The realization of load transfer without blackouts can improve the reliability of a power supply, reducing economic loss. Hence, we summarize the problems appearing during loop closing and opening processes. Based on this analysis, a loop closing operation was executed at one 110 kV substation, and the voltage and current waveform were recorded. A theoretical analysis of field experiments results yielded the spectral characteristics of the system. A loop closing operation was simulated using EMTP-ATP software. The simulation and the field experiment results matched closely, thus validating the simulation model. We conclude that closing and opening operation are influenced by voltage difference, including the amplitude and phase angle difference. The system capacitance and inductance have impact not only on the transient over- voltage, but also on the frequency characteristics of the system.

articleTitle: Optimized Electro-Optical Detection System for a FEL-THz Source
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: A detection system based on electro-optical(EO) sampling is designed for the established high-power, wide-band and wave-tunable FEL-THz source at Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST). The phase mismatch and dispersion propagation of the femtosecond laser pulse in the crystal are the main reasons that cause the distortion of the EO signal. We theoretically calculate and analyze the mixing process of the probe pulse and THz pulse in the crystal. Calculating the coherence length to find the suitable center wavelength probe for different detected crystals (ZnTe, Gap, GaAs). In addition, our simulation results show that the broadband laser can eliminate the effect caused by phase mismatch between the THz phase velocity and the group velocity of the laser in different crystals (ZnTe, Gap, GaAs). Moreover, the experiment results of 3-mm-thick ZnTe with sampling laser of 100nm bandwidth agree the simulation results well. The research is meaningful for optimizing the EO sampling system in the future.

articleTitle: Test Device for Evaluating Electrical Contact Properties of Contact Materials Based on Eddy Current Repulsion Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: To improve the evaluating ability of the electrical contact properties of the materials, a test device with a good comprehensive performance is designed based on eddy current repulsion mechanism. The working principle, mechanical structure and driving circuit of the device are introduced. A prototype of the device is made and tested. The result shows that the device has a wide range of speed regulation, wide application scope and small volume.

articleTitle: Damping Performance Analysis of Power System Electromechanical Oscillations Considering the Proportion and Position of PV Generations
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the frequent occurrence of electromechanical oscillation in the power systems, the fast response characteristics of the photovoltaic (PV) power generation system are used to actively damp the electromechanical oscillation in the power system. The proportion and position of PV generations in the system are usually different, therefore, the dynamic process of PV damping the grid electromechanical oscillation will also be changed. This paper divides the conventional system into two parts: the power system and the infinite power grid, the steady-state output of the PV generation system is equivalent to the active output current Id0 and the reactive output current Iq0. The analysis conclusions of these two parts shows that: the inertia level, synchronization and damping effect of the conventional system will increase with the increase of Id0, and first decrease with the increase of Iq0, then increase rapidly, and then decrease. Moreover, the closer the PV module to the electromechanical oscillation source, the better the oscillation damping effect. Finally, this paper verifies the conclusion correctness through MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Research on The Influence of Structural Parameters of Augmented Linear Drive on Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In order to study the influence of key structural parameters on the efficiency of augmented high pulse current linear drive device, based on COMSOL and MATLAB, the variation tendency of drive efficiency with the number of rails, the distance between the metal shell and the rail, the distance between the inner rails and the outer rails, the length of rails, the height of rails and the width of rails are analyzed by parameter scanning. And the genetic algorithm is used to solve optimal efficiency of the drive device. In general, the efficiency tends to present a unimodal distribution when the rails cross-section parameters vary. Based on the research method and conclusion, it has a positive guiding significance for the design of drive structure parameters for different launch requirements.

articleTitle: Magnetic Shielding of Wireless Power Transfer Using Zero Permeability Metamaterial Slab
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Electromagnetic radiation generated by the wireless power transfer (WPT) can be harmful to humans and environment. In order to satisfy the safety requirements, electromagnetic leakage to the nearby transmission channels should be controlled below a safe level. Except for the ferrite and metallic shielding materials, several researchers have put forward the zero-permeability metamaterial (ZP-MM). However, there have been few scientific studies with the application of ZP-MM in four-coil WPT systems. In this paper, we propose an optimized ZP-MM for shielding leaked magnetic field. Next, we setup a miniaturized WPT system loaded with ZP-MM at 13.56MHz. As a result, when ZP-MM is used, the transmission efficiency is reduced about 28.8% and the magnetic field magnitude of the receiver has been decreased about 72.7%, compared to free space. To better highlight the shielding effect, the aluminum plate is inserted in the middle of the Tx and Rx coils. The results show that the shielding effect of ZP-MM is better than aluminum plate. Obviously, the proposed ZP-MM has good performance in magnetic field shielding for WPT systems.

articleTitle: Research on supersonic and subsonic vacuum arc simulation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, according to the magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) model of vacuum arc, vacuum arc is regarded as a two-fluid model of mixing electrons and ions, and the momentum equation, mass equation and energy equation of the fluid are coupled with the magnetic transfer equation and Maxwell equations. After that, the momentum equation and energy equation are secondary developed in Fluent, and the momentum equation and energy equation in Fluent are modified. According to the different characteristics of supersonic arc and subsonic arc, different anode boundary, cathode boundary and side boundary, namely fluid wall boundary conditions are set, and supersonic arc and subsonic arc are solved in fluent. The relationship between arc current and arc pressure, arc density, arc velocity and axial current density in supersonic arc and subsonic arc is obtained.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of VFTO under Different Reignition Arc Models of Isolating
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The accuracy of the arc description of the isolation switch is a key factor affecting the calculation accuracy of the fast transient overvoltage (VFTO). In the current simulation calculation, the commonly used resistance model is equivalent to isolating the switching arc, so that it is impossible to deeply simulate the changes of various state quantities during the arc development process. Therefore, based on the theory of multiple reignition arcs and the theory of segmented arcs, this paper compares and analyzes three equivalent models of isolating switch arcs, and calculates and analyzes the internal VFTO of a gas insulated substation (GIS) in a 550kV power station. It is proved that the model can simulate the physical process of the arc during the operation of the isolating switch more accurately, and it is practical for the numerical calculation and characteristic analysis of VFTO.

articleTitle: Construction of Pulsed Rotating Magnetic Field Ionization Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: A new experiment platform has been constructed to study the ionization with a rotating magnetic field, which is 2 meters in length and 35 cm in diameter. Two sets of antennas with a diameter of 40cm are fed separately by two pulsed power units based on thyratron. The maximum discharge voltage exceeds 40 kV with current 20kA, and the frequency is 83 kHz. Adjust the phase difference of the two power supply currents by 90 degrees to form a rotating magnetic field. The background magnetic field at the central axis of the vacuum chamber is 500G, corresponding to current of 400 A. Total capacitive stored energy is 30 kJ. A set of gas-puffing injecting system have been designed and installed. In this work, We will mainly describe our rotating magnetic field experimental platform in detail.

articleTitle: Study on Chain Arc Extinguishing under the Action of Explosion Flow
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The arc extinguishing force produced by the explosive airflow device is an important factor affecting the arc extinguishing time. This paper studies the influence of the explosive airflow produced by the device on the arc extinguishing time from the angle of arc motion. Using the chain arc model and arc extinction arc length criterion, the arc extinction time under different nozzle angle and flow velocity parameters when the fault current was 1kA was simulated and compared with the test results, the simulation value was basically consistent with the actual value. The extinction time of arc is related to the velocity of explosive flow. In the case of the same faulty arc current, the extinction time of arc decreases with the increase of airflow velocity, this shows the feasibility of the explosive airflow arc extinguishing device in the performance of arc extinguishing.

articleTitle: Study on Corona Discharge Diagnosis Method in Daylight Environment Based on Visible Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Partial discharge is one of the major causes of power equipment failures and operation accidents. Discharges in daylight environment are difficult to be observed due to the weak light signal. Digital images are often used to study corona discharge. However, ultraviolet cameras have limitations such as low pixels, high prices. This paper proposes a new method for diagnosing corona discharge in daylight environment. Based on the needle-plate electrode air gap discharge structure, we use a common visible light camera to take photos of the discharge. By converting the photo from RGB to HIS color space, we extract the hue and intensity information of each pixel. Analogous to the spectrogram, we propose the hue-intensity spectrum. After correlating the Hue-Intensity spectrum with the applied voltage value during discharge and the discharge images in a dark light environment, we found that the newly proposed spectrum has a good division effect in the discharge development stage. Meanwhile, we found that the corona inception voltage can be roughly estimated from the curve graph of relative brightness and applied voltage. This method provides a new idea for the diagnosis of discharge in daylight environment.

articleTitle: A Multi-Process Hybrid Communication Network and Its Application in EMS for Micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Equipment in the distributed micro-grid have the characteristics of wide distribution, large number, different protocols, and small inertia. In order to make effective monitoring of off-grid micro-grid and achieve stable operation, the Energy Management System (EMS) needs a real-time and reliable communication network to ensure the coordinated operation of system. This paper proposes a proven solution, which adopts hybrid communication infrastructure based on the "three-layer and two-network" concept and multi-process software framework. The specific network is given from hardware and software, and successfully applied to an EMS of an island micro-grid. The field operation verifies the real-time and reliability of the communication network, and that it can provide effective information for the micro-grid.

Author Keywords: the real-time and reliability of communication network

articleTitle: Research on Design and Security application of AVC System in Plant Station under Interconnected Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 1st China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
